## Highlights
- Restores reliable macOS menu status decoding for both autoregressive and image-generation models. - Keeps loaded-model identity, activity, and runtime policy visible while status refreshes are in flight. - Adds bounded automatic recovery when a status refresh or worker-policy update is temporarily unavailable. - Strengthens shared Rust and Swift contracts for complete menu-facing status documents.
## Compatibility
Astronomical 0.2.10 supports Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later. The DMG is signed, Apple-notarized, and stapled for Gatekeeper verification. The update archive and feed remain protected by Sparkle Ed25519 signatures.
Existing model directories, configuration, prompt caches, and logs remain in place when updating from 0.2.9.
